title: How an Expense Ratio Compounds Against a 30-Year Balance
title_alts: Expense Ratio: the yearly percentage taken from your whole balance
The Mistake of Reading an Expense Ratio as a Fee on Gains
description_hook: An expense ratio is charged on the entire balance every year, not on the year's gain. This walks through the arithmetic with round illustrative figures.

characters.name: the ruled notebook
characters.description: a plain ruled notebook on a wooden desk, a pen and a pocket calculator beside it, soft daylight, one page always lying open

scenes.narration: This video is for general education only and is not financial advice. Please speak to a qualified adviser before making any money decision. Every figure here is illustrative.
scenes.caption: यह वीडियो केवल सामान्य शिक्षा है, वित्तीय सलाह नहीं। फ़ैसले से पहले सलाहकार से बात करें।
scenes.image_brief: A plain ruled notebook open on a wooden desk beside a pen and a pocket calculator, morning daylight from a window, no people

scenes.narration: 2 percent a year sounds small. Over 30 years it can quietly remove about a third of a balance.
scenes.caption: साल में 2 प्रतिशत छोटा लगता है। 30 साल में यह बैलेंस का लगभग तिहाई ले सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A tall glass jar of coins on a wooden desk with a third of the coins poured out into a small dish beside it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The cost is not charged on the profit. It is charged on the whole balance.
scenes.caption: यह लागत मुनाफ़े पर नहीं लगती। यह पूरे बैलेंस पर लगती है।
scenes.image_brief: A wide low pile of coins on a wooden desk with a thin sliver of coins separated from its edge, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Every year. Including on money the same charge already reduced last year.
scenes.caption: हर साल। उस पैसे पर भी जिसे यही कटौती पिछले साल घटा चुकी है।
scenes.image_brief: A long row of thirty small coin stacks receding across a wooden desk, one coin lifted off the top of each stack, soft daylight

scenes.narration: That is the whole mechanism. The rest is arithmetic.
scenes.caption: पूरा तरीक़ा यही है। बाक़ी सब गणित है।
scenes.image_brief: A ruled notebook lying open at a blank page on a wooden desk with a pencil resting in the crease, soft daylight

scenes.narration: An expense ratio is the yearly cost of running a pooled fund. It covers management, record keeping and distribution.
scenes.caption: एक्सपेंस रेशियो साझा फ़ंड चलाने की सालाना लागत है। इसमें प्रबंधन और हिसाब-किताब शामिल है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed fund fact sheet lying on a wooden desk with one line marked by a yellow highlighter, soft daylight

scenes.narration: It is quoted as a percentage of the money the fund is holding.
scenes.caption: यह फ़ंड में रखी रक़म के प्रतिशत के रूप में बताया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small paper wedge cut from a large round paper disc, both lying on a ruled notebook page on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: No invoice arrives. Nothing leaves a bank account.
scenes.caption: कोई बिल नहीं आता। बैंक खाते से कुछ नहीं कटता।
scenes.image_brief: An open empty letterbox with no envelopes inside it, mounted on a residential wall in daylight

scenes.narration: The cost is taken inside the fund, before the value for the day is published.
scenes.caption: लागत फ़ंड के अंदर ही कट जाती है, उस दिन का मूल्य छपने से पहले।
scenes.image_brief: A kitchen scale on a wooden desk holding a jar of coins, with one coin lying beside the scale, soft daylight

scenes.narration: So the published return already has the charge removed from it.
scenes.caption: इसलिए छपा हुआ रिटर्न शुल्क घटने के बाद का होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A folded newspaper on a wooden desk showing a table of numbers, a pen lying across it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The statement never flags it. So it is rarely reviewed.
scenes.caption: स्टेटमेंट इसे कभी अलग से नहीं दिखाता। इसलिए समीक्षा कम होती है।
scenes.image_brief: A bank statement page with plain unmarked rows lying on a wooden desk, a pen resting across it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: A small percentage of a large base is not a small number.
scenes.caption: बड़े आधार का छोटा प्रतिशत छोटी रक़म नहीं होती।
scenes.image_brief: A single small coin resting on top of a very large mound of coins on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: And that base grows in every year the fund grows.
scenes.caption: और जिस साल फ़ंड बढ़ता है, वह आधार भी बढ़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: Three mounds of coins of increasing size standing in a row on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Three things will be clear by the end of this.
scenes.caption: अंत तक तीन बातें साफ़ हो जाएँगी।
scenes.image_brief: A ruled notebook page with three empty numbered lines drawn in pencil, a pen beside it on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: First, what the percentage is actually multiplied by.
scenes.caption: पहली, यह प्रतिशत असल में किस रक़म से गुणा होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A multiplication sign drawn in pencil on a ruled notebook page between a single coin and a tall stack of coins, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Second, why the rupee cost climbs while the percentage stays still.
scenes.caption: दूसरी, प्रतिशत स्थिर रहते हुए भी रुपये में लागत क्यों बढ़ती है।
scenes.image_brief: A percent symbol drawn in pencil on a notebook page beside four coin stacks of increasing height, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Third, why 30 years hurts far more than one year does.
scenes.caption: तीसरी, 30 साल का असर एक साल से कहीं ज़्यादा क्यों होता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two calendars lying side by side on a wooden desk, one a single thin page and one a thick block of year pages, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Start with the base, because every rupee of the cost follows from it.
scenes.caption: आधार से शुरू करें, क्योंकि लागत का हर रुपया उसी से निकलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wide rectangle drawn in pencil on a ruled notebook page with coins resting inside its outline, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The percentage applies to the entire holding. Principal and past growth together.
scenes.caption: प्रतिशत पूरी रक़म पर लगता है। मूलधन और पुरानी बढ़त, दोनों पर।
scenes.image_brief: A wide block of coins on a notebook page divided by a pencil line into one large area and one smaller area, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Not to this year's gain alone.
scenes.caption: सिर्फ़ इस साल के मुनाफ़े पर नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A small handful of coins held apart from a large block of coins on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Picture a balance of 1 lakh rupees, purely as an illustration.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए बैलेंस 1 लाख रुपये है, केवल उदाहरण के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy bundle of banknotes lying on a ruled notebook page on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: A 2 percent ratio takes about 2,000 rupees out of it that year.
scenes.caption: 2 प्रतिशत का रेशियो उस साल उसमें से लगभग 2,000 रुपये लेता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small pinch of coins lying beside a tidy bundle of banknotes on a ruled notebook page, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Now let the balance grow. The rate stays exactly where it was.
scenes.caption: अब बैलेंस को बढ़ने दें। दर ठीक वहीं बनी रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Five bundles of banknotes stacked in a pile on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The base underneath it does not.
scenes.caption: उसके नीचे का आधार वहीं नहीं रहता।
scenes.image_brief: A tall stack of coins standing on a wide wooden block on a desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: At 5 lakh, that same 2 percent is 10,000 rupees.
scenes.caption: 5 लाख पर वही 2 प्रतिशत 10,000 रुपये बनता है।
scenes.image_brief: A larger pinch of coins lying beside five bundles of banknotes on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: At 10 lakh, it is 20,000 rupees.
scenes.caption: 10 लाख पर यह 20,000 रुपये है।
scenes.image_brief: Ten bundles of banknotes on a wooden desk with a handful of coins set aside beside them, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Same rate. Ten times the rupees.
scenes.caption: दर वही। रुपये दस गुना।
scenes.image_brief: A small pinch of coins and a much larger pile of coins lying side by side on a ruled notebook page, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Now the second half of the mechanism, which is the bigger half.
scenes.caption: अब तरीक़े का दूसरा हिस्सा, जो असल में बड़ा हिस्सा है।
scenes.image_brief: A ruled notebook turned to a fresh page with a single pencil line down the middle, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Money removed this year cannot compound next year.
scenes.caption: इस साल निकाला गया पैसा अगले साल नहीं बढ़ सकता।
scenes.image_brief: A small clay pot of soil on a wooden desk with an empty hole where a seed has been taken out, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Or in any year after that one.
scenes.caption: और उसके बाद किसी भी साल में नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A row of empty clay pots of dry soil standing along a windowsill in daylight

scenes.narration: So each deduction costs the slice, plus everything that slice would have earned.
scenes.caption: हर कटौती वह हिस्सा लेती है, और उस हिस्से की पूरी कमाई भी।
scenes.image_brief: A coin held above an empty clay pot beside another pot holding a tall green seedling, soft daylight

scenes.narration: That is 30 deductions. Each one loses its own future.
scenes.caption: यानी 30 कटौतियाँ। हर एक अपना भविष्य भी खो देती है।
scenes.image_brief: Thirty small clay pots arranged in rows on a wooden table, each with an empty hole in the soil, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Growth compounds upward. The charge compounds against it.
scenes.caption: बढ़त ऊपर की ओर चक्रवृद्धि करती है। शुल्क उसके विरुद्ध।
scenes.image_brief: A rising staircase of coin stacks on a wooden desk with a descending staircase drawn in pencil on the page beneath it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Two curves, leaving the same balance and bending in opposite directions.
scenes.caption: एक ही बैलेंस से निकलकर उलटी दिशाओं में मुड़ती दो रेखाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: Two curved lines drawn in pencil on a ruled notebook page, starting from one point and bending apart, soft daylight

scenes.narration: And in a losing year, the percentage is still taken.
scenes.caption: और घाटे के साल में भी प्रतिशत वसूला जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A coin being lifted from a shrinking pile of coins on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Take two accounts. Every number here is illustrative.
scenes.caption: दो खाते लीजिए। यहाँ हर आँकड़ा केवल उदाहरण है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical glass jars of coins standing side by side on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Both start at 1 lakh rupees and both stay invested for 30 years.
scenes.caption: दोनों 1 लाख रुपये से शुरू होते हैं और 30 साल तक टिके रहते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical jars filled with coins to the same level, a thick calendar block beside them on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Assume the investments inside both grow 10 percent a year before costs.
scenes.caption: मान लें दोनों के निवेश लागत से पहले साल में 10 प्रतिशत बढ़ते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical jars of coins with a small measuring cup of coins resting between them on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: That growth rate is an assumption. It is round, not a forecast.
scenes.caption: यह बढ़त दर एक मान्यता है। यह गोल आँकड़ा है, भविष्यवाणी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A pencil note written on a ruled notebook page lying between two jars of coins, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The first account carries an expense ratio of 0.5 percent.
scenes.caption: पहले खाते का एक्सपेंस रेशियो 0.5 प्रतिशत है।
scenes.image_brief: The left jar of two coin jars with a single coin resting on its lid, on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The second carries 2 percent.
scenes.caption: दूसरे का 2 प्रतिशत है।
scenes.image_brief: The right jar of two coin jars with four coins resting on its lid, on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Nothing else differs between them.
scenes.caption: इनके बीच और कोई अंतर नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical jars of coins side by side on a wooden desk, one with a single coin on the lid and one with four, soft daylight

scenes.narration: After costs, the first compounds at about 9.5 percent a year.
scenes.caption: लागत के बाद पहला लगभग 9.5 प्रतिशत सालाना की दर से बढ़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: The left jar of coins standing noticeably fuller than the jar beside it on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The second compounds at about 8 percent.
scenes.caption: दूसरा लगभग 8 प्रतिशत की दर से बढ़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: The right jar of coins standing filled lower than the jar beside it on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Thirty years later, the first holds roughly 15 lakh rupees.
scenes.caption: तीस साल बाद पहले में लगभग 15 लाख रुपये होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A tall column of banknote bundles standing beside a jar of coins on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The second holds roughly 10 lakh.
scenes.caption: दूसरे में लगभग 10 लाख रुपये होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A shorter column of banknote bundles standing beside a jar of coins on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: 5 lakh rupees apart. The gap came from 1.5 percentage points.
scenes.caption: 5 लाख रुपये का अंतर। यह 1.5 प्रतिशत अंक से आया।
scenes.image_brief: Two unequal columns of banknote bundles on a wooden desk with a wooden ruler laid across the space between them, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Where did that 5 lakh go?
scenes.caption: वे 5 लाख रुपये कहाँ गए?
scenes.image_brief: An empty patch of wooden desk between two unequal columns of banknote bundles, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Part of it left as charges, one year at a time.
scenes.caption: इसका एक हिस्सा साल-दर-साल शुल्क के रूप में गया।
scenes.image_brief: A shallow tray holding a small heap of coins beside two columns of banknote bundles, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The larger part is growth those charges never got to earn.
scenes.caption: बड़ा हिस्सा वह बढ़त है जो यह शुल्क कभी कमा ही नहीं पाया।
scenes.image_brief: A large empty woven basket standing beside a shallow tray of coins on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: In year one the two accounts differ by about 1,500 rupees.
scenes.caption: पहले साल दोनों खातों में लगभग 1,500 रुपये का अंतर होता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two jars of coins with almost the same coin level, the small difference marked by a pencil line, soft daylight

scenes.narration: By year 30, the yearly difference is many times that.
scenes.caption: 30वें साल तक सालाना अंतर उससे कई गुना हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two jars of coins with very different coin levels, each level marked by a pencil line, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The ratio is not the full cost of owning a fund.
scenes.caption: यह रेशियो फ़ंड रखने की पूरी लागत नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: Several printed statement pages fanned out on a wooden desk, only one of them marked with a highlighter, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Exit charges, taxes and the fund's own trading costs sit outside it.
scenes.caption: एक्ज़िट शुल्क, कर और फ़ंड की ख़रीद-बिक्री की लागत इसके बाहर रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Three separate small coin trays standing apart from a single jar of coins on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: So a low ratio does not prove a low total cost.
scenes.caption: इसलिए कम रेशियो कुल लागत कम होने का सबूत नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: One small jar of coins beside a thick heap of paper receipts on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: The opposite mistake is just as common.
scenes.caption: उलटी गलती भी उतनी ही आम है।
scenes.image_brief: A ruled notebook page with a subtraction written twice in pencil and the second one crossed out, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Published returns are usually already net of the ratio.
scenes.caption: छपे हुए रिटर्न आम तौर पर रेशियो घटाने के बाद के होते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed performance table lying on a wooden desk with a pen resting beside it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Subtracting it a second time counts the same cost twice.
scenes.caption: इसे दूसरी बार घटाना उसी लागत को दो बार गिनना है।
scenes.image_brief: The same number written twice on a ruled notebook page, one of the two entries crossed out in pencil, soft daylight

scenes.narration: A ratio also says nothing about how a fund will perform.
scenes.caption: रेशियो यह भी नहीं बताता कि फ़ंड कैसा प्रदर्शन करेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A jar of coins standing beside a completely blank sheet of paper on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: It is a cost. Not a result.
scenes.caption: यह एक लागत है। नतीजा नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A small paper price tag lying on an otherwise blank ruled notebook page, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Ratios also differ by fund type, because the work behind them differs.
scenes.caption: रेशियो फ़ंड के प्रकार से भी बदलता है, क्योंकि उसका काम अलग होता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two different printed fund fact sheets lying side by side on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: And across a single year, the compounding barely shows up at all.
scenes.caption: और एक ही साल में चक्रवृद्धि का असर लगभग दिखता ही नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A single calendar page for one year lying flat on a wooden desk beside a jar of coins, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Return to the opening number. 2 percent, once a year.
scenes.caption: शुरुआती आँकड़े पर लौटें। साल में एक बार 2 प्रतिशत।
scenes.image_brief: A percent symbol drawn in pencil and circled on a ruled notebook page, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Small as a rate. Large as a base, multiplied 30 times over.
scenes.caption: दर के रूप में छोटा। आधार पर 30 बार गुणा हो तो बड़ा।
scenes.image_brief: A single coin lying beside a very tall stack of coin piles on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: It is not a share of the profit.
scenes.caption: यह मुनाफ़े का हिस्सा नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A small paper wedge lying apart from a large round paper disc on a ruled notebook page, soft daylight

scenes.narration: It is a share of everything, taken again each year.
scenes.caption: यह पूरी रक़म का हिस्सा है, जो हर साल फिर लिया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A round paper disc with thirty thin wedges cut out all around its face, lying on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: And every share carries its own future away with it.
scenes.caption: और हर हिस्सा अपने साथ अपना भविष्य भी ले जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A cut paper wedge lying beside an empty clay pot of dry soil on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: That is why the holding period matters more than the number does.
scenes.caption: इसीलिए रखने की अवधि इस आँकड़े से ज़्यादा मायने रखती है।
scenes.image_brief: Two calendars lying on a wooden desk, one a thin single page and one a very thick block of pages, soft daylight

scenes.narration: One percentage point costs almost nothing in a single year.
scenes.caption: एक प्रतिशत अंक एक साल में लगभग कुछ भी नहीं लेता।
scenes.image_brief: A single coin resting on a calendar page for one year on a wooden desk, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Across a working life, it reshapes the ending balance.
scenes.caption: पूरे कामकाजी जीवन में यह आख़िरी बैलेंस को बदल देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A long row of coin stacks stretching across a long wooden table, the far end of the row noticeably lower, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Find the total expense ratio on the latest fund statement.
scenes.caption: ताज़ा फ़ंड स्टेटमेंट में कुल एक्सपेंस रेशियो ढूँढें।
scenes.image_brief: A fund statement page lying on a wooden desk with a pen pointing at one line of it, soft daylight

scenes.narration: Write it down. Compare it with last year's number.
scenes.caption: उसे लिख लें। पिछले साल के आँकड़े से मिलाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A ruled notebook on a wooden desk with a number written on the page and a pen resting beside it, soft daylight

title_alts: An Emergency Fund Buys the Right to Choose When You Sell
The Mistake of Paying a Repair Bill From a Long-Term Holding
description_hook: An emergency fund is not a savings goal. It is a buffer that stops an unexpected bill from choosing the day a long-term holding gets sold, and this explainer walks that arithmetic with round, illustrative figures.

characters.name: the notebook
characters.description: a plain ruled notebook with a pen and a small calculator on a wooden desk, soft daylight from one window, a single corner of a page turned down

scenes.narration: This video is for general education only and is not financial advice. Please speak to a qualified adviser before making any money decision.
scenes.caption: यह केवल सामान्य शिक्षा है, वित्तीय सलाह नहीं। फ़ैसले से पहले योग्य सलाहकार से बात करें।
scenes.image_brief: A plain ruled notebook, a pen and a small calculator arranged on a wooden desk, soft daylight from a window, generous empty space above them.

scenes.narration: Nobody plans to sell at the bottom. The bill decides.
scenes.caption: कोई तल पर बेचना नहीं चाहता। तारीख़ बिल तय करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed repair invoice lying on the same wooden desk beside the closed notebook, warm afternoon light across the paper.

scenes.narration: A gearbox does not check the market before it breaks.
scenes.caption: गियरबॉक्स टूटने से पहले बाज़ार का हाल नहीं देखता।
scenes.image_brief: An opened car bonnet in a small repair garage with a cracked gearbox housing set on the floor, cool light from a ceiling lamp.

scenes.narration: It fails on its own schedule, and it wants money this week.
scenes.caption: वह अपने समय पर बिगड़ता है, और पैसा इसी हफ़्ते मांगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar in a garage office with one date circled in red pen, dim daylight through a dusty window.

scenes.narration: The fall is not the expensive part. The timing is.
scenes.caption: गिरावट महंगी नहीं होती। महंगा उसका समय होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall clock and a stack of banknotes side by side on a wooden desk, the clock face catching the light.

scenes.narration: Household money usually sits in two piles with two different jobs.
scenes.caption: घर का पैसा आम तौर पर दो अलग कामों वाले हिस्सों में रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two shallow wooden bowls on a kitchen table, one holding coins and one holding a folded paper certificate, even morning light.

scenes.narration: One pile is for use. The other is for growth.
scenes.caption: एक हिस्सा खर्च के लिए। दूसरा बढ़ने के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: The same two bowls with small handwritten paper tags propped against them, soft daylight on the table.

scenes.narration: The growth pile is supposed to be left alone for years.
scenes.caption: बढ़ने वाले हिस्से को सालों तक छूना नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: A sealed brown envelope pushed to the back of a wooden drawer, thin light falling in as the drawer stands half open.

scenes.narration: Its value wanders up and down the whole time it waits.
scenes.caption: इंतज़ार के दौरान उसकी कीमत ऊपर-नीचे होती रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: A pencil line drawn across a sheet of graph paper, rising and dipping, the sheet lying on a desk in soft daylight.

scenes.narration: On any single day, that value is close to arbitrary. Genuinely arbitrary.
scenes.caption: किसी एक दिन की कीमत लगभग बेतुकी होती है। सचमुच बेतुकी।
scenes.image_brief: A single day torn from a desk calendar lying face up on graph paper, one point of the drawn line marked with a dot, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Does an emergency check what the market is doing that week? It never has.
scenes.caption: क्या आपात खर्च बाज़ार का हाल देखकर आता है? कभी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A leaking ceiling pipe dripping into a steel bucket in a hallway at night, a bare bulb lighting the water.

scenes.narration: So the two piles collide, and it is the growth pile that gives way.
scenes.caption: दोनों हिस्से टकराते हैं, और बढ़ने वाला हिस्सा ही हारता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two wooden bowls knocked together on a table, coins scattered from one and the other tipped over, hard side light.

scenes.narration: That collision is the exact thing an emergency fund exists to prevent.
scenes.caption: इमरजेंसी फंड इसी टकराव को रोकने के लिए होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small wooden block set between the two bowls to keep them apart on the same table, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Three things follow from here.
scenes.caption: आगे तीन बातें निकलती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A notebook open to a clean page with three short pencil ticks down the margin, warm desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: First, why a forced sale costs more than the price it fetches.
scenes.caption: पहली, मजबूरी की बिक्री मिलने वाली कीमत से ज़्यादा क्यों ले जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A price tag and an invoice pinned side by side on a corkboard, the invoice showing the larger figure, even daylight.

scenes.narration: Second, how a cash buffer removes the force without touching the fall.
scenes.caption: दूसरी, नकद बफ़र गिरावट नहीं, बेचने की मजबूरी हटाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A pencil arrow on notebook paper crossed out while the dipping line beside it stays untouched, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Third, where the idea stops working and what it cannot cover.
scenes.caption: तीसरी, यह तरीका कहाँ काम करना बंद कर देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A notebook page with its lower third torn away, the ragged edge lying on a wooden desk in flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Start with what a long-term holding actually is, underneath the label.
scenes.caption: पहले समझें कि लंबी अवधि का निवेश असल में क्या है।
scenes.image_brief: A paper certificate of holding unfolded on a wooden desk beside a magnifying glass, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: It is a count of units, multiplied by a price.
scenes.caption: वह यूनिट की गिनती है, कीमत से गुणा की हुई।
scenes.image_brief: Twelve identical small brass tokens laid out in a grid on a desk beside a single price card, even daylight.

scenes.narration: The units are yours. The price never is.
scenes.caption: यूनिट आपकी हैं। कीमत कभी आपकी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The same brass tokens gathered in a pair of cupped hands above the desk while the price card lies apart, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Price is set by everyone else, and it is reset every day.
scenes.caption: कीमत बाकी सब तय करते हैं, और हर दिन नई बनती है।
scenes.image_brief: A public display board of changing figures in a quiet hall, the board glowing against dim surroundings.

scenes.narration: Across a long stretch of years, that price has tended to climb.
scenes.caption: लंबे सालों में यह कीमत ऊपर जाती रही है।
scenes.image_brief: A long pencil line rising gently across two taped-together sheets of graph paper on a table, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Along the way it also falls, and sometimes it falls hard.
scenes.caption: बीच में यह गिरती भी है, कभी बहुत तेज़ी से।
scenes.image_brief: The same rising pencil line with three deep notches cut downward into it, the paper creased, harder light.

scenes.narration: Here is the part that gets missed. A fall is only a number.
scenes.caption: यहीं चूक होती है। गिरावट सिर्फ़ एक आंकड़ा है।
scenes.image_brief: A single figure written in pencil on notebook paper with nothing beside it, wide empty margins, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: It becomes real only when units leave and cannot come back.
scenes.caption: नुकसान तभी सच होता है जब यूनिट हाथ से निकल जाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: Brass tokens tipped out of a jar onto a desk and rolling toward the edge, hard afternoon light.

scenes.narration: While the units stay put, nothing has actually been lost.
scenes.caption: जब तक यूनिट बनी हैं, असल में कुछ नहीं गया।
scenes.image_brief: A sealed glass jar of brass tokens sitting untouched on a wooden shelf, dust in the air, soft window light.

scenes.narration: A recovery, whenever it comes, works only on the units still held.
scenes.caption: रिकवरी सिर्फ़ बची हुई यूनिट पर काम करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A jar of brass tokens standing beside a rising pencil line drawn on the wall behind it, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: Sell a portion, and there are fewer units left to recover.
scenes.caption: कुछ बेच दें, तो रिकवरी के लिए कम यूनिट बचती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The same jar visibly emptier beside the same rising line on the wall, the line unchanged, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: The rebound then happens on a smaller base, forever.
scenes.caption: फिर उछाल हमेशा के लिए छोटे आधार पर होता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two jars side by side, one full and one part empty, each with a pencil arrow rising above it, the shorter arrow reaching lower, even daylight.

scenes.narration: That part is permanent. The fall was the temporary bit.
scenes.caption: यह हिस्सा पक्का है। गिरावट अस्थायी थी।
scenes.image_brief: A pencil line that dips and returns, with one short section erased away and left blank, on graph paper in soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Now put the emergency back in, with its own unmoveable date.
scenes.caption: अब आपात खर्च जोड़ें, अपनी तय तारीख़ के साथ।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar with a single date circled in red beside a jar of brass tokens on a shelf, cool morning light.

scenes.narration: If the only reachable money sits in units, the date picks the sale.
scenes.caption: अगर पैसा सिर्फ़ यूनिट में है, तो तारीख़ बिक्री तय करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A red-circled calendar date and a jar of tokens joined by a length of string across a desk, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: The expense chooses the price. No holder would choose that price.
scenes.caption: खर्च कीमत चुनता है। कोई धारक ऐसी कीमत नहीं चुनेगा।
scenes.image_brief: An invoice resting directly on top of a price card on a wooden desk, the card mostly hidden, low side light.

scenes.narration: A cash buffer cuts that link in one move.
scenes.caption: नकद बफ़र इस कड़ी को एक झटके में तोड़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A pair of scissors cutting the string between the calendar and the jar of tokens on the desk, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: The bill is paid with money that never carried a market price.
scenes.caption: बिल उस पैसे से चुकता है जिसकी कोई बाज़ार कीमत नहीं थी।
scenes.image_brief: A stack of banknotes from a tin box laid on top of an invoice on a kitchen table, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: The units stay. The sale date stays a choice.
scenes.caption: यूनिट बनी रहती हैं। बेचने का दिन मर्ज़ी से तय होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A closed jar of brass tokens on a shelf and a calendar with no date circled, both in soft even daylight.

scenes.narration: Round figures from here, illustrative only, and not a forecast of anything.
scenes.caption: आगे के आंकड़े गोल और उदाहरण भर हैं, कोई भविष्यवाणी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A notebook page headed with round pencil figures and the word illustrative underlined, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Two households own long-term holdings that are identical in every way.
scenes.caption: दो परिवारों के पास हर तरह से एक जैसा निवेश है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical glass jars of brass tokens standing on a kitchen shelf, matched in every detail, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Each holding is worth 5 lakh rupees at its high point.
scenes.caption: ऊँचाई पर हर निवेश की कीमत 5 लाख रुपये है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical jars each with a small paper tag reading five lakh, sitting on the shelf in soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Then the price falls 20 percent, for reasons neither household caused.
scenes.caption: फिर कीमत 20 प्रतिशत गिरती है, किसी की गलती से नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The same two jars with their paper tags replaced, each now reading four lakh, cooler grey light through a window.

scenes.narration: Both holdings now read 4 lakh on the screen.
scenes.caption: अब दोनों निवेश स्क्रीन पर 4 लाख दिखाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A household screen on a desk showing one lower figure and a downward line, the room dim around it.

scenes.narration: Same units as before. Lower price.
scenes.caption: यूनिट पहले जितनी ही। कीमत कम।
scenes.image_brief: Two jars holding the same visible level of tokens beside two price tags showing smaller figures, even light.

scenes.narration: In that same month, a repair bill lands on both doormats.
scenes.caption: उसी महीने मरम्मत का बिल दोनों घरों पर आता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical repair invoices lying on two different doormats in a shared corridor, dull daylight from a stairwell.

scenes.narration: The bill is 80,000 rupees, and it will not wait.
scenes.caption: बिल 80,000 रुपये का है, और यह इंतज़ार नहीं करेगा।
scenes.image_brief: A single repair invoice on a kitchen table with a red stamp in its corner, no cash anywhere near it, harsh daylight.

scenes.narration: The first household has nothing set aside. No cash at all.
scenes.caption: पहले परिवार ने कुछ अलग नहीं रखा। नकद बिल्कुल नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: An open tin cash box on a kitchen shelf, completely empty, thin light reaching the bare bottom.

scenes.narration: So it sells units worth 80,000 at the lower price.
scenes.caption: तो वह गिरी कीमत पर 80,000 की यूनिट बेच देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Brass tokens counted out of one jar onto a table beside a price tag showing the lower figure, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: That is one fifth of every unit it owned, gone.
scenes.caption: यह उसकी हर पाँचवीं यूनिट थी, अब गई।
scenes.image_brief: A jar with a fifth of its tokens removed and set aside in a small heap, the gap clearly visible, side light.

scenes.narration: At the earlier price, those same units would have fetched 1 lakh.
scenes.caption: पुरानी कीमत पर वही यूनिट 1 लाख दिलातीं।
scenes.image_brief: The same small heap of tokens beside the older higher price tag, the tag propped against the jar, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: The bill was 80,000. Clearing it consumed 1 lakh of holding.
scenes.caption: बिल 80,000 का था। चुकाने में 1 लाख का निवेश गया।
scenes.image_brief: An invoice and a larger handwritten figure on notebook paper laid side by side on a desk, the larger figure circled, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Months later, the price climbs back to where it began.
scenes.caption: कुछ महीनों बाद कीमत वापस पुराने स्तर पर आ जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A pencil line on graph paper climbing back to its original level, a ruler laid flat along the old level, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: The units that remain are worth 4 lakh, not 5.
scenes.caption: बची हुई यूनिट 4 लाख की हैं, 5 लाख की नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: The part-empty jar standing beside its neighbour, the token level clearly lower, both on a bright shelf.

scenes.narration: The second household paid the identical bill out of its cash buffer.
scenes.caption: दूसरे परिवार ने वही बिल अपने नकद बफ़र से चुकाया।
scenes.image_brief: A tin cash box open on a kitchen table with banknotes inside and a stamped invoice beside it, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: Its holding is worth 5 lakh again. The difference is 20,000.
scenes.caption: उसका निवेश फिर 5 लाख का है। अंतर 20,000 का है।
scenes.image_brief: Two jars on a shelf, one filled to the top and one slightly below, with the gap marked in pencil on the wall between them, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: None of this makes the 20 percent fall disappear.
scenes.caption: इससे 20 प्रतिशत की गिरावट गायब नहीं होती।
scenes.image_brief: A grey overcast window above a kitchen shelf holding both jars, the same dull light on each.

scenes.narration: Both households watched the same 20 percent drop. Only one had to act.
scenes.caption: दोनों ने वही 20 प्रतिशत गिरावट देखी। कदम एक को उठाना पड़ा।
scenes.image_brief: Two kitchen tables side by side, one holding an emptied jar and one holding an open cash box, even daylight.

scenes.narration: The buffer removes the obligation to sell, and nothing else.
scenes.caption: बफ़र सिर्फ़ बेचने की मजबूरी हटाता है, और कुछ नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A pair of open hands beside an untouched jar on a table, the jar lid still sealed, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: It carries a real cost too. Cash grows slowly.
scenes.caption: इसकी कीमत भी है। नकद धीरे बढ़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A tin box of banknotes on a shelf with a thin layer of dust on the lid, still afternoon light.

scenes.narration: A buffer stretched too large simply becomes money doing nothing.
scenes.caption: ज़रूरत से बड़ा बफ़र बस बेकार पड़ा पैसा है।
scenes.image_brief: An oversized jar crammed with banknotes taking up an entire kitchen shelf while the other shelves stand bare, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: So what sets the size? Months of fixed costs, not ambition.
scenes.caption: आकार क्या तय करता है? तय खर्च के महीने, महत्वाकांक्षा नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A notebook page with a short column of month names written in pencil and a bracket drawn beside them, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: The most common mistake is parking the buffer in the same market.
scenes.caption: सबसे आम गलती बफ़र को उसी बाज़ार में रखना है।
scenes.image_brief: A tin cash box sitting inside a glass display case of moving figures in a dim hall, the case lit from within.

scenes.narration: Then it falls on precisely the day it was needed most.
scenes.caption: फिर वह ठीक उसी दिन गिरता है जब उसकी ज़रूरत होती है।
scenes.image_brief: The same tin box tipped open inside the display case with the figures behind it low, cold light on the spilled notes.

scenes.narration: A buffer is also not insurance, and cannot stand in for it.
scenes.caption: बफ़र बीमा भी नहीं है, और उसकी जगह नहीं ले सकता।
scenes.image_brief: An insurance policy booklet and a small tin cash box lying apart on a wooden desk with a clear gap between them, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: A hospital bill running into many lakhs is a different problem.
scenes.caption: कई लाख का अस्पताल बिल बिल्कुल अलग समस्या है।
scenes.image_brief: A long hospital billing statement unrolled across a desk and running off the edge, bright clinical light.

scenes.narration: Back to the opening line. Nobody plans to sell at the bottom.
scenes.caption: पहली बात पर लौटें। कोई तल पर बेचना नहीं चाहता।
scenes.image_brief: The very first repair invoice back on the wooden desk beside the closed notebook, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Nobody does it on purpose. The money simply had to come from somewhere.
scenes.caption: कोई जान-बूझकर ऐसा नहीं करता। पैसा कहीं से आना ही था।
scenes.image_brief: A jar, an invoice and an empty chair at a kitchen table, nobody present, quiet daylight.

scenes.narration: Something in the house broke, and the repair could not wait.
scenes.caption: घर में कुछ टूटा, और मरम्मत रुक नहीं सकती थी।
scenes.image_brief: A burst pipe joint under a kitchen sink with a puddle spreading across the floor tiles, dim daylight.

scenes.narration: The market was never the decision maker. The calendar was.
scenes.caption: फ़ैसला बाज़ार ने कभी नहीं किया। कैलेंडर ने किया।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar hanging where a figures display board once hung on a plain wall, soft daylight across it.

scenes.narration: So an emergency fund is not really about emergencies at all.
scenes.caption: तो इमरजेंसी फंड असल में आपात हालात के बारे में नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A tin cash box on a desk with a wall calendar propped inside its open lid, warm daylight.

scenes.narration: It is about who gets to choose the day a holding is sold.
scenes.caption: यह इस बारे में है कि बेचने का दिन कौन चुनता है।
scenes.image_brief: A calendar page with one date circled in pencil rather than red, the pencil resting on the page, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Its return never shows up as interest on a statement.
scenes.caption: इसका फ़ायदा ब्याज़ बनकर किसी कागज़ पर नहीं दिखता।
scenes.image_brief: A blank interest statement lying face up on a desk with no figures printed on it, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: It shows up as a sale that never had to happen.
scenes.caption: यह उस बिक्री के रूप में दिखता है जो कभी करनी नहीं पड़ी।
scenes.image_brief: A jar of tokens standing intact on a shelf beside a torn and discarded sale slip, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: The same arithmetic works with any set of figures.
scenes.caption: यही गणित किसी भी आंकड़ों पर काम करता है।
scenes.image_brief: The plain ruled notebook open on the wooden desk with fresh round figures written in pencil, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: One sheet of paper is enough to run it.
scenes.caption: इसे करने के लिए कागज़ का एक पन्ना काफ़ी है।
scenes.image_brief: A single sheet of paper, a pen and a calculator laid out on the wooden desk, generous empty space, soft daylight.
